title: Unsupervised Learning of Cell Instances with Generative Routing Pyramids
abstract: arXiv:2608.16810v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Identifying and representing object instances such as cells or nuclei is a common task in microscopy image analysis. Established machine learning workflows typically use supervised detection or segmentation followed by feature extraction or classification, which requires manual annotations and treats instance segmentation and cell representation as separate stages. We describe a new unsupervised method for cell instance segmentation and phenotypic classification from unlabeled microscopy images. Our method is based on reconstructing each image using a coarse-to-fine routing pyramid that associates pixels with spatially sparse latent sources. The resulting pixel-to-latent associations yield instance masks, while the source latents encode cell morphology. We demonstrate competitive performance in instance segmentation across diverse cell morphologies and imaging modalities, as well as generative modeling of cellular phenotypes under pert

translated_title: 基于生成路由金字塔的无监督细胞实例学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16810v1 公告类型：跨领域  摘要：在显微镜图像分析中，识别和表示如细胞或细胞核等对象实例是一项常见任务。已建立的机器学习工作流程通常采用监督式检测或分割，随后进行特征提取或分类，这需要手动注释，并将实例分割和细胞表示视为独立阶段。我们描述了一种从无标签显微镜图像中进行细胞实例分割和表型分类的新无监督方法。该方法基于使用一个从粗到细的路由金字塔重建每张图像，该金字塔将像素与空间稀疏的潜在源相关联。由此产生的像素到潜在源的关联生成实例掩膜，而源潜在编码细胞形态。我们在不同细胞形态和成像模式的实例分割中展示了竞争性能，以及在扰动下细胞表型的生成建模。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需标注的无监督方法，通过粗到细的路由金字塔将像素与稀疏潜在源关联，同时实现细胞实例分割和形态编码，在多种成像条件下表现优异。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an unsupervised method using a coarse-to-fine routing pyramid to associate pixels with sparse latent sources, enabling simultaneous cell instance segmentation and morphology encoding, with competitive performance across diverse imaging conditions.
